subject: 英语
topic: Unit 4 When is the art show
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】first 第一; second 第二; third 第三; fourth 第四; fifth 第五; twelfth 第十二; twentieth 第二十; special 特殊的; fool 傻瓜
【重点句型】When is ...? ……在什么时候？ It's on ... 在……（具体日期）。 It's on April 4th. 在4月4日。 Whose birthday? 谁的生日？ The ... is on ... ……在……
【A Let's talk】Mr Jones: When is the art show? Zhang Peng: It's on May 1st. Mr Jones: When is the reading festival? Zhang Peng: It's on May 5th. Mr Jones: Great!
【Read and write】We have special days. The school art show is on May 1st. The reading festival is on May 5th. My birthday is on June 2nd. My mother's birthday is on July 4th. My father's birthday is on December 12th.
